title: नकली Bank Agent vs वफादार कुत्ता 😱 | Dog Saves Grandma's Pension | Hindi Story
category: Wild And Domestic Animals Helping Humans In Their Life
hook_text: नकली बैंक वाला आया… पर मोती ने पहचान लिया!
look: Photorealistic live-action Indian television drama, shot on a cinema camera, natural skin texture, warm morning sunlight in a small-town North Indian home, shallow depth of field

characters.name: Kamla Devi
characters.role: widow who lives alone with her street dog
characters.face: thin, gentle oval face with deep laugh lines, warm dark-brown eyes behind round gold-rimmed glasses, wheatish-brown wrinkled skin, silver-grey hair in a low bun with a centre parting, small red bindi, slightly stooped, slim build, about 5 feet tall
characters.voice: an elderly woman's soft, slightly shaky, warm voice

characters.name: Ramesh
characters.role: con man pretending to be a bank agent
characters.face: sharp narrow face, thin trimmed moustache, small shifty dark eyes, medium-brown skin with light acne marks on the cheeks, short oiled black hair combed to the side, lean build, about 5 feet 8 inches, a fake polite smile
characters.voice: a smooth, fast-talking, falsely polite male voice

characters.name: Moti
characters.face: medium-sized Indian pariah dog with a short golden-brown coat, white chest patch, pointed upright ears, curled tail, alert amber eyes and a black nose, lean and athletic, a red cloth collar

characters.name: Constable Sunil
characters.face: broad square face, thick black moustache, kind but stern dark eyes, dark-brown sun-tanned skin, short greying hair under a khaki beret, sturdy heavy build, about 5 feet 10 inches
characters.voice: a deep, firm, authoritative male voice

1.kamla: a plain off-white cotton saree with a thin maroon border, a grey woollen shawl, thin gold bangles
1.ramesh: a light-blue formal shirt, dark trousers, a black office bag and a blank blue lanyard card on his chest
1.sunil: a khaki Indian police uniform with a brown leather belt and a khaki beret

scenes.place: a small courtyard of an old North Indian house with a tulsi pot and a hand pump, morning
scenes.action: Medium shot: Kamla Devi sits on a low wooden stool and lovingly feeds a roti to Moti, stroking his head; the dog wags his tail
scenes.speaker: kamla
scenes.line: खा ले मोती, आज तेरी पसंद की रोटी है।
scenes.sound: Morning birds and a distant pressure cooker whistle

scenes.place: the wooden front door of the same house, morning
scenes.action: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Kamla Devi: Ramesh stands at the open door with a fake polite smile, holding up a blank card, speaking to her
scenes.speaker: ramesh
scenes.line: अम्मा जी, बैंक से आया हूँ, आपका खाता बंद हो रहा है।

scenes.place: the wooden front door of the same house, morning
scenes.action: Close-up of Kamla Devi, filmed from just behind Ramesh's shoulder: her face fills with fear, she clutches her shawl
scenes.speaker: kamla
scenes.line: हाय राम! मेरी पूरी पेंशन उसी खाते में है बेटा।

scenes.place: inside the small sitting room of the house, morning
scenes.action: Medium two-shot: Ramesh leans in towards Kamla Devi and holds out his open palm, speaking softly and urgently
scenes.speaker: ramesh
scenes.line: बस अपना ATM कार्ड और पिन दे दीजिए, मैं ठीक कर दूँगा।

scenes.place: inside the small sitting room of the house, morning
scenes.action: Low-angle shot from the floor: Moti steps between Kamla Devi and Ramesh, ears back, baring his teeth and growling at Ramesh, who steps back nervously
scenes.sound: A low, menacing dog growl and a ceiling fan

scenes.place: inside the small sitting room of the house, morning
scenes.action: Moti leaps up, snatches the blank lanyard card from Ramesh's chest with his teeth and dashes out of the door; Ramesh lunges after him and shouts
scenes.speaker: ramesh

scenes.place: a narrow sunlit lane of a small Indian town with parked scooters, morning
scenes.action: Moti drops the card at Constable Sunil's feet; Sunil picks it up, looks at it, then glares down the lane as Ramesh comes running and freezes
scenes.speaker: sunil
scenes.line: ये तो वही ठग है, जिसकी फोटो थाने में लगी है!
scenes.sound: A busy lane, a distant bicycle bell

scenes.place: the courtyard of the house with the tulsi pot, late morning
scenes.action: Kamla Devi kneels and hugs Moti tightly with tears of relief, kissing his head; the dog licks her cheek
scenes.speaker: kamla
scenes.line: आज तूने मेरी ज़िंदगी भर की कमाई बचा ली, मोती।

youtube.description:
एक नकली बैंक वाला अकेली अम्मा जी की पेंशन लूटने आया… पर उनके वफादार कुत्ते मोती ने सब बदल दिया! 🐕
A fake bank agent tries to steal a lonely grandmother's pension, but her loyal street dog sees through him.

#HindiStory #DogStory #MoralStory #FamilyDrama #Shorts
